description_en: Queries the cross-account authorization information of a specified network instance (VPC, VBR, or CCN) in Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN)
description_zh: 查询指定网络实例（VPC、VBR和CCN）的云企业网跨账号授权信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-grant-rules-to-cen --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id vpc-bp18sth14qii3pnvc0000 --instance-type VPC --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeGrantRulesToCen

parameters.help_en: The region of the network instance to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的网络实例所在的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network instance to query
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance to query. Valid values:

VPC: virtual private cloud (VPC).

VBR: Virtual Border Router.

CCN: Cloud Connect Network
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的网络实例的类型，取值：

VPC：专有网络。

VBR：边界路由器。

CCN：云连接网
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the network instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的网络实例所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

schema.description_en: The number of entries per page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
